title: frasera tetrapetala f. leucantha
intro: Frasera tetrapetala f. leucantha, commonly known as White Columbine or Four-leaf Mountain Mint, is a perennial plant species belonging to the gentian family (Gentianaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, thereby providing health benefits such as wound healing and the relief of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Frasera tetrapetala f. leucantha include its ability to relax muscles, reduce fever, and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
